notes.title: [UPDATE 1.7] The Invincible - Cosmic Pierogi
notes.content:
[h3]Tomorrow, space will welcome the second Polish astronaut![/h3][p][/p][p][u][url="https://plinspace.pl"]Mission IGNIS[/url][/u] starts at [b]2:22 pm CEST[/b], when a Falcon 9 rocket with the crewed Dragon capsule will launch from the John F. Kennedy Space Center in Florida.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748592/e77a48a148651c0f70418b94606765ab28fae029.png"][/img][/p][p]Among the four-person Ax-4 crew is [b]Dr Sławosz Uznański-Wiśniewski[/b], a Polish astronaut of the European Space Agency. He will become the second Pole in history to travel to space, and the first to spend time aboard the International Space Station (ISS).
[/p][p]As part of the IGNIS mission, the Polish astronaut will conduct 13 experiments developed by Polish companies and universities. The research will span a wide range of fields, including astronaut health, the human microbiome, new materials, and advanced technologies.[/p][p][/p][h3]From Poland’s milk bar to the Milky Way![/h3][p][/p][p][b]To celebrate it, we have prepared a rover skin based on an internationally acclaimed Polish dish that Sławosz will bring into space: Cosmic Pierogis[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748592/afae3c81a73bf085b78ba98bdf4a8aa10bb17e09.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy its unique taste and bring its flavour together with you to each corner of Regis III.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748592/0b90dd539d3f1c89638a1fa9b9e2e1feafd71542.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Every astroscientist deserves comfort food after they face mind-boggling phenomena that make them rethink everything they know about human species, science and the universe.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748592/976fb85fb65c09e3dcd33d14fd6fbb36a20e1258.png"][/img][/p][p]
- Starward Industries & 11 bit studios[/p]

notes.title: [UPDATE 1.4.1] The Invincible - Working Class Hero
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Astronaut,[/h3]

[b]Today we celebrate heroes of the working class across multiple universes![/b]

They work to put food on their families’ tables and use jobs as tools to convince people in power to answer their demands. Whether they work in mines, on streets or shipbreaker stations - they all share a potential waiting to be discovered.

[h3]Frostpunk 2[/h3]

Discover [b]a new rover skin inspired by the freshly released Frostpunk 2[/b]. Take a break from your duty as Steward and traverse the landscapes of Regis III in search of knowledge beyond human understanding.
And if you feel nostalgic, you can also play the first part of Frostpunk from our bundle:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/36437/Frostpunk_x_The_Invincible/

[h3]Hardspace: Shipbreaker[/h3]

[b]A new, Shipbreaker-inspired rover skin awaits you on Regis III[/b]. In between your commissions on the spaceship salvaging station, take a rover ride to find your missing astrocrew and discover mind-boggling science phenomena.
And if you are strong-willed enough, you can try to tackle both games at the same time:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45104/The_Invincible_x_Hardspace_Shipbreaker/

[h3]Additionally:[/h3]
- Improvements to the memory optimization

notes.title: Voyager Update is out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748592/898b452a4115cece189c5e64d167b1b18ca22923.jpg[/img]

[h3]Astronaut,[/h3]

[i]Look at the foreign horizon. Stretching wide before you, inviting you to search through its every nook and cranny. Reddish sand gives way to the force of your feet walking briskly toward the unknown. You open the rover’s door, sit behind the wheel and start the engine. Somehow it feels as if a completely new perspective unfolds in front of your eyes. You can only imagine what mind boggling discoveries await you on Regis III…[/i]

[b]The Invincible Voyager Update is here![/b] We have enhanced the exploration of Regis III and improved a few elements of your astromission. Thank you, astronauts, for supporting us along this journey! We are awaiting your feedback regarding the improvements, so [b]let us know what you think in the comments, Discussions or on our [url=https://www.discord.com/invite/7CMcj3ZEp6]Discord[/url][/b].

[previewyoutube=Yt7OTT0iFXQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's new in the Voyager Update:[/h2]

[h3][b]Dynamic Camera Views during Rover ride[/b][/h3]
Experience the thrill of exploring Regis III from a new perspective... Now, with our latest update, you can switch your camera from First-Person (FPP) to Third-Person (TPP) during your Rover ride. It’s time to dive into a world of scientific wonder and look at astounding landscapes from a new angle.

[h3][b]Enhanced Walk & Sprint Speed in some locations[/b][/h3]
We have tweaked the speed in which Yasna travels through Regis III, as it was an adjustment you highly requested. Further improvements are limited due to the expanded dialogue system and the pacing problems that would occur if Yasna were to move faster. However, we still wanted to enhance your gameplay experience in this matter, so we gave Yasna a little boost wherever it was possible.

[h3][b]New Story slides to discover[/b][/h3]
The scope of mysteries awaiting to be discovered by you has expanded with additional slides scattered across Regis III. Unearth these hidden treasures to delve deeper into the rich lore and mysteries of the planet. Each discovery brings you closer to unraveling the mind-boggling phenomena of Regis III…

[h3][b]*Experimental Feature: Wider FOV in Accessibility Settings[/b][/h3]
We have heard loud and clear your desire to have a wider FOV option. Our team has been working on finding a way to do that without breaking the game almost from the release date. During this process, we have widened the FOV from 70 to 80 and then 90. We found out that further FOV iterations may cause some technical problems, i.e.:[list]
[*] HUD interaction icons start to move around, which may cause problems with the navigation and controls
[*] proportions of environmental elements and NPCs are changing unnaturally
[*] one can see holes in the spacesuit
[/list]
However, given that the wider FOV is one of the most requested features of The Invincible and that we really want to enhance your immersion on this otherworldly mission, [b]we decided to release an experimental feature of wider FOV (100, 110, 120) for those of you who want to try it out[/b].

You will be able to use it freely and see whether this partial solution works for you. In the near future we will try to minimize a part of the visual and gameplay issues coming from wider FOVs.

The only important thing to keep in mind is that [b]wider FOV settings may result in higher performance demand[/b] - it works similarly to choosing a higher quality of graphics. Apart from that, we hope that this new feature will be to your liking!

You can [b]access the experimental FOV by following two steps:
1. Toggle on experimental FOV option in the Accessibility Settings tab.
2. Go to the Graphics tab and change the FOV.[/b]


[b]Additionally:[/b][list]
[*] Added in-game input to directly launch comics, allowing you also to dive into your unique play story with the possibility to enlarge exact frames.
[*] Changed flashbacks fade in/out color.
[*] Added an option in accessibility to turn off automatic interactions.
[*] Updated decal appearance to indicate the possibility to climb.
[*] Bug fixes for some camera movement and slides inspect mode.
[*] Minor animation and audio adjustments.
[*] Performance and UI issue fixes.
[*] Minor localization adjustments.
[/list]

Take care!

notes.title: [HOTFIX 1.0.3] Spacecraft Repairs: ultrawide support, hardlocks & UI
notes.content:
[i]We want to thank every astronaut who has submitted a bug report or shared their feedback with us, and all of the astroscientists that have already taken part in The Invincible’s cosmic adventure! Together with your help, we have improved the playing experience on Regis III. Here is the list of changes coming with hotfix 1.0.3.[/i]

[h3]Minimum requirements[/h3]

PS Just a reminder: after the hotfix 1.0.2. [b]we have lowered the PC requirements[/b]. Our performance tests proved that The Invincible will run on graphics cards with 2GB or 3GB RAM. In Full HD on High and Epic settings, the game should work at around 25-30 FPS. [b]If you have AMD R7 260x (2GB) or Nvidia GTX 760 (2GB), you can enjoy the cosmic adventure to the fullest now[/b].

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]

[b]We have heard loud and clear the voice of our supporters who would enjoy playing The Invincible on ultrawide resolutions, so we added the ultra widescreen support to the game. Enjoy![/b]

- [b]Fixed various hardlocks and softlocks[/b] reported by players (old saves should also work properly in these cases):
(a) [b]the possibility of getting stuck before reaching 4th Gorsky's point in the objective ‘Find Dr. Gorsky’[/b],
(b) the incorrect checkpoint save on the 4th point, which spawned the player in the wrong place after loading,
(c) the possibility of getting stuck next to the antimat in the convoy area.
- Fixed the position of a saucer after the crash.
- Fixed a relay transmitter usage (showing/hiding) and added its missing shadow.
- Different minor quest/level design bug fixing (e.g. dialogue timings, hints and interaction improvements).
- Improved body and camera movement while holding or using equipment.
- Improved controller input (it should feel more natural now).
- Improvements and further optimization for screen resolution and other graphic settings.
- UI/UX improvement for language settings (full language names instead of codes).
- UI/UX improvements for gamma settings.
- Some animation and environmental polishing.
- Minor SFX/VFX bug fixing and polishing.
- Several localization fixes.

notes.title: [HOTFIX 1.0.2] Spacecraft Repairs: PC requirements, DLSS & hardlocks
notes.content:
[i]Big thank you to every astronaut who has submitted bugs/feedback, and thank you all for taking part in The Invincible’s cosmic adventure!
Since the release we have been working hard to solve as many of the reported issues as possible. Here’s another part of spacecraft improvements.[/i]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Save system[/h3]

- Thank you for all your feedback about the game's save system. We have made [b]a small improvement for now, but we plan to make more fundamental changes to this system[/b] in the near future as a part of a larger patch. 
Since this hotfix, [b]a separate backup of your save is made before every new checkpoint[/b]. This will allow you to manually overwrite your chosen slot save in case you meet any hardlock or want to go back to the exact moment of your playthrough.

All your saves can be found in this folder:
C:\Users\<user_name>\AppData\Local\TheInvincible\Saved\SaveGames

[h3]Minimal requirements[/h3]

- More astronauts are now able to take part in the mission on Regis III as we have optimized the game for older graphics cards with 2GB or 3GB RAM. In Full HD on High and Epic settings, the game should work at around 25-30 FPS.
Due to this improvement, [b]we are changing the minimal requirements for graphics to AMD R7 260x (2GB) or Nvidia GTX 760 (2GB)[/b].

[h3]DLSS[/h3]

- [b]Added presets for DLSS quality settings[/b].

[h3]Other improvements[/h3]

- Fixed various hardlocks and softlocks reported by players (old saves should also work properly in these cases):
- further fixes for a missing interaction of the passage between rocks in the City area,
- further fixes for Yasna getting stuck next to the window in one of the game's endings (the song's fault!),
- the possibility of getting blocked by an invisible wall on the 4th point looking for Gorsky and on the Convoy force field area,
- some cases with missing rover interactions,
- a possibility to avoid climbing interaction and blocking the game ending on the cliff,
- a double hint for a stuck vehicle in the Convoy area,
- a possibility to get stuck next to the landed probe in the Base area,
- general problems with hiding the equipment or map.
- Fixed several areas where players were able to get stuck between the landscape/props collisions (e.g. Base, City).
- Improved teleprobe behavior (crazy speeding and duplicating itself).
- Different minor quest/level design fixes.
- Default frame rate settings are now set based on the graphic quality preset.
- Fixed map layout reload from checkpoint.
- Fixed lighting parameters for Rohytra mesh during the battle scene.
- Some animation, environmental, and lighting fixes and polishing.
- Audio volume fixes for character voice-overs (e.g. inaudible Novik lines) and SFX for footsteps.

[h3]Issue reporting[/h3]

From now on, [b]when encountering any issues, you can also send us additional telemetric data from the game level[/b], which will significantly speed up the debugging process. Just [b]press CTRL+C during the game, open a Notepad, press CTRL+V and save the file[/b], and include this as an attachment in the [url=https://11bitstudios.com/faq/?filter_game=the-invincible]support form[/url]. Please, also attach your save files and a DxDiag report:

1. How to save a DxDiag report?

1. Click on Start.
2. Type "DxDiag" and launch DxDiag.
3. Click on "Save all information".
4. Save "Dxdiag.txt" file.

2. How to find your saves from the game?

If you downloaded the game to the C disk, you should find them in:
C:\Users\user_name\AppData\Local\TheInvincible\Saved\SaveGames

notes.title: [HOTFIX 1.0.1] Spacecraft Repairs: hardlocks, audio & other bugs
notes.content:
[i]Big thank you to every astronaut who has submitted bugs/feedback, and thank you all for taking part in The Invincible’s cosmic adventure!
Since the release we have been working hard to solve as many of the reported issues as possible.[/i]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]

- Fixed various hardlocks and softlocks reported by players:
   - the possibility of getting stuck in the rover on the way to the Convoy area,
   - no interaction of the passage between rocks in the City area (with general quests flow and checkpoints problems in this area),
   - [EDIT: the issue remains, we are now intensely working on resolving it completely) Yasna getting stuck next to the window in one of the game's endings,
   - possibility of getting stuck under the Antimat leg.
- Fixed forcing the dialogue to end and handling its different states; fixes for old saves (e.g. hardlock in the command unit in the base area with access to the 2nd floor).
- Fixed several areas where players were able to leave the playable area or fall under the map going by foot or driving a rover (e.g. digging sites around the excavation pit, base area, landing area, path to battle area).
- Fixed several areas where players were able to get stuck between the landscape/props collisions (e.g. dead body in the old base area). 
- Different minor quest/level design fixes reported by the players and QA.
- Checkpoints loading improvements.
- Fixed the bug with Yasna’s four hands and blocked the detector at the beginning area.
- Fixed the rare bug with controller/keyboard focus in the main menu.
- Fixed problems with cancel/exit default input and binding. 
- Fixed a camera collision with the player when using photo mode.
- Fixed overlapping dialogue lines in the base area.
- Fixed the incorrect loading of sound effects in the City area.
- Fixed rover speed parameters.
- Performance and optimization fixes (e.g. graphic settings, FPS drops, texture loading).
- Lighting and shadow fixes. 
- Some animation and camera parameters fixes and polishing.
- Fixed footstep sounds after Yasna’s blackout during the storm.
- Added missing sounds for some animations.
- Steam Deck: setting the largest font size as default.

*The Invincible has now appeared on GeForce Now page of supported games.

[i]Thank you for reading our spacecraft notice. We hope you'll enjoy the mind-boggling journey of discovering scientific phenomena and rethinking everything you know about the universe even more now![/i]

notes.title: The Invincible is out now
notes.content:
[h2]Astronaut,[/h2]

[b]Our spacecraft has landed on Regis III. This is the last notice from Interplanetary Commonwealth HQ before you take your first step on the eerie land of the unknown and unthinkable.[/b]

[b]The Invincible is ready for launch[/b]. We are extremely grateful for your continuous support over the last years and happy that we could finally bring this unique, hard sci-fi adventure to you. Below, you can find the most important information about the game & find out where to write about any issues you may encounter (or simply talk about the game :)).

Psst… If you wonder how much there is to uncover, let us say that you can get to [b]11 different endings[/b]. Enjoy the new launch trailer!

[previewyoutube=uvNGTLPAIPI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]PC REQUIREMENTS[/h3]

As you may have seen, after going through multiple internal and external rounds of the game testing, we lowered the initial PC requirements. They are as follows:

Minimum
Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (6 core with 3,5 Ghz) or Intel i5-10400F (6 core with 2,9 Ghz)
Memory: 16 GB RAM changed to 8 GB RAM
Graphics: Radeon 5600xt (6GB) or Nvidia GTX 1060 (6GB) changed to Radeon 6500XT (4GB) or Nvidia GTX 1660 (4GB)/1060 (6GB)
Storage: 25 GB changed to 40 GB

Recommended
Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (6 core with 3,5 Ghz) or Intel i5-10400F (6 core with 2,9 Ghz)
Memory: 32 GB RAM changed to 16 GB RAM
Graphics: Radeon 6700xt (12GB) or Nvidia GTX 2070 Super (8GB) changed to Radeon 6600XT (8GB) or Nvidia GTX 1660 Ti (6GB)
Storage: 25 GB changed to 40 GB

*The Invincible supports the multichannel sound system 5.1.


[h3]STEAM DECK VERIFIED[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748592/ceb5e26d5451ee8e8609cb60547cb670def1b2de.jpg[/img]

You can now experience our hard sci-fi, philosophical adventure wherever in the cosmic plane you will find yourself… The Invincible is Steam Deck Verified.


[h3]WHERE CAN I REPORT ISSUES?[/h3]

Our team will be available to answer your questions and help you with any possible issues here on Steam or on our Discord server. We have prepared [b]two new Steam discussion categories for you - Important Info and Tech Support[/b]. In the Important Info we will post a FAQ in which you can find most of the important answers you are looking for. In the Tech Support you can report a bug/glitch/other issue with the game that you encountered. Please, describe it in as much detail as possible (screenshots will be much appreciated) and we will try to help you with the issue as soon as possible :)

[u][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/731040/discussions/4/][b][STEAM] IMPORTANT INFO[/b][/url][/u]

[u][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/731040/discussions/3/][b][STEAM] TECH SUPPORT[/b][/url][/u]

[u][url=https://discord.com/invite/7CMcj3ZEp6][b]DISCORD SERVER[/b][/url][/u]


[b]Thank you for taking part in the exploratory mission on Regis III, for your immense determination, and courage. We are proud to leave the future of scientific discoveries and human might in your hands. Take care, astronaut. And remember not to leave anyone behind.[/b]


[b]More info on our social media  ||  STARWARD INDUSTRIES[/b]
